Preserve the company's operating and investment history, add the bankruptcy milestone, and replace all three dead citations with current primary evidence.

afterImage.name: Noventa Energy Partners
afterImage.subsector: Wastewater energy transfer and thermal networks
afterImage.description: Noventa Energy Partners developed and operated wastewater energy transfer systems that provided low-carbon heating and cooling to institutional and commercial buildings under long-term energy-as-a-service structures. The asset-heavy platform built district-scale thermal systems connected to wastewater networks. Ancala acquired a majority interest through Ancala Infrastructure Fund III in 2023, while the Canada Infrastructure Bank announced a C$100 million commitment to support Canadian deployment. Noventa Energy Partners Inc. and six related Noventa Group entities entered bankruptcy effective March 20, 2026, and MNP was appointed as licensed insolvency trustee. Noventa is therefore no longer treated as an active operating platform or current Ancala portfolio company.

Noventa Energy Partners Inc. and six related Noventa Group entities entered bankruptcy, with MNP appointed as licensed insolvency trustee.
